name: 35650 · Moulton, AL
findings: ZIP 35650 (Moulton) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35650 (Moulton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
